title: 漫画风格品牌识别信息图

categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,漫画 / 分镜,产品营销,漫画 / 图像小说,插画,角色,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en: 使用上传的标志，创建一张高度细节化的漫画风信息图海报：nn⸻nn《这个品牌的感觉是什么》nn目标（GOAL）：nn将品牌转化为一个“活着的个体”，并通过视觉方式展示它如何行为、说话以及与世界互动。nn整体感觉应融合：品牌策略 + 角色设计 + 漫画叙事nn⸻nn核心规则（CORE RULE）：nn所有内容必须来源于Logo本身：nn颜色n风格n语气n个性nn❌ 不允许使用通用、泛化的人格描述nn⸻nn主要结构（MAIN STRUCTURE）：nn竖版 4:5 海报n信息密集，多面板布局n漫画 + 信息图混合风格nn⸻nn顶部区域（TOP SECTION）：nn品牌名称n简短个性声明（最多6个词）n示例：n“安静的自信，锋利的边界”nn⸻nn主角色（MAIN CHARACTER｜非常重要）：nn创建一个代表品牌的核心角色：nn品牌的人格化形象n服装体现品牌风格n姿态与表情体现个性nn⸻nn角色周围（AROUND THE CHARACTER）：nn设计 6–8个漫画分镜，展示品牌在不同情境下的行为。nn⸻nn情境示例（SCENARIO IDEAS）：nn与客户交流n面对竞争对手n销售产品n社交媒体表现n面对批评n日常“品牌生活”瞬间nn⸻nn每个分镜需包含（FOR EACH PANEL）：nn简短标题（最多6个词）n对话气泡或内心独白n清晰的视觉动作nn⸻nn语气示例（TONE EXAMPLES）：nn奢侈品牌：冷静、自信、语言简洁n活泼品牌：夸张、混乱、表达丰富n科技品牌：精准、理性、干净nn⸻nn人格特征模块（PERSONALITY TRAITS SECTION）：nn用小模块展示：nn语气风格（如：冷静 / 大胆 / 玩味）n能量水平（低 / 中 / 高）n社交属性（内向 / 外向）n沟通方式nn使用：nn图标n简短标签nn⸻nnDO / DON’T 模块：nn分成两个区域：nnDO（应该）：nn品牌应有的行为nnDON’T（避免）：nn破坏品牌形象的行为nn⚠️ 保持极简短表达nn⸻nn视觉元素（VISUAL ELEMENTS）：nn对话气泡n图标n箭头n小反应表情n夸张漫画表情nn⸻nn风格（STYLE）：nn漫画 + 编辑设计混合n略带夸张，但保持高级感n表达丰富但不幼稚nn⸻nn配色（COLOR）：nn严格基于 Logo 的配色n用颜色强化品牌个性nn⸻nn层次与细节（DEPTH）：nn20–40个视觉元素n多个小分镜n分层构图nn⸻nn重要规则（IMPORTANT RULES）：nn必须“有生命感”n必须具体、有辨识度n❌ 不使用泛化营销语言n❌ 不留空白区域n文案短但有冲击力nn⸻nn最终效果（FINAL FEEL）：nn应像：nn一个被角色化的品牌策略n一块视觉叙事板n让人愿意收藏与研究的作品nn而不是：nn平面、单调nn泛化、无个性nn极简空洞

title: 比萨斜塔冰淇淋透视提示
author: CHAse
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特
prompt_en:
[Subject] Refer to Image 1 and Image 2

[Pose and Expression]
Standing with the Leaning Tower of Pisa in the background, smiling contentedly with the head tilted slightly toward the upper left. Holding an ice cream waffle cone in the left hand, positioned using perspective so the tower looks like soft-serve ice cream on top of the cone. Specify the perspective so the tower sits exactly like ice cream on the waffle cone.

[Outfit]
Wearing a simple black one-shoulder sleeveless top.

[Hair and Makeup]
Neat long natural hair parted in the center, draped calmly over the shoulders. Wearing black round cat-eye sunglasses and silver/pearl drop earrings. Long almond-shaped nails with pastel pink and yellow gradient.

[Lighting]
Intense direct midday sunlight from the upper right front on a clear day. Bright highlights on the face and shoulders, with sharp, high-contrast shadows on the chest and clothes caused by the hand and cone.

[Texture and Mood]
Vibrant contrast between the clear blue sky, green grass, and beige historic buildings. Vivid textures of the waffle cone and glossy sunglasses for a lively summer vacation mood.

[Camera Settings]
Medium close-up snapshot at eye level, aperture f/1.8, focal length 5.4mm, ISO 100, shutter speed 1/2000s. Reflects smartphone wide-angle characteristics with sharp focus on the person and cone, while the distant buildings are softly out of focus. Person is on the left of the frame, tower on the right.

[Background]
Duomo Square in Pisa, Italy. The leaning white marble tower is on the right, and the domed Pisa Cathedral is on the left. Manicured green grass between them under a cloudless blue sky.

[Signature] A small Threads logo at the bottom right with the name \

Include exactly 3 floating islands with grass tops and small dome structures: one mid-left, one mid-right, and one tiny distant island near the right side. Decorate the foreground with small flowers and bushes. Use saturated colors, clean vector-like outlines, soft lighting, gentle bloom around glowing objects, and a playful mobile-game aesthetic reminiscent of a friendly sci-fi platformer splash screen. title: 黑暗动漫鬼灭之刃海报
author: Samuel Ferrero.
categories: 海报 / 传单,漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,漫画 / 图像小说,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a gritty vertical anime movie poster for Tanjiro Kamado, inspired by dark shonen fantasy and Demon Slayer aesthetics, with a ruined battlefield atmosphere, dramatic flames, water breathing effects, and distressed vintage typography.

Canvas: Tall poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, full bleed, with a thin double-line tan border and aged paper texture. Use a high-detail painterly manga style with rough ink lines, film grain, soot, scratches, ember particles, and warm orange-black contrast.

Main subject: Center a teenage swordsman in a dark uniform and green-black checkered haori, standing in a powerful three-quarter pose. He has spiky burgundy-black hair, hanafuda-style earrings, and an intense heroic silhouette. His face area is covered by a plain medium-brown rectangular censor block, while the hair, ears, neck, and body remain visible. He grips a katana with both hands near his waist, angled diagonally upward to the left. The blade is wrapped in bright turquoise-blue water energy, with one distinct curling water slash sweeping from the lower center toward the upper left. The haori should look torn and windblown, with many ragged pieces flowing outward.

Background: A burning demon-slaying battlefield at night. Show a large ghostly profile portrait of the same swordsman in the smoky sky behind him, facing right, with glowing reddish highlights. Include one ruined Japanese pagoda/building on the right midground, one tattered vertical banner on the right with dark calligraphy, collapsing wooden structures and rubble along the bottom, flying ash, black debris, sparks, and red-orange fire clouds. The overall mood is apocalyptic, heroic, and tragic.

Typography and layout: Make the design look like a Japanese theatrical poster mixed with a Spanish title treatment. Include exactly these visible text groups:
1. Large vertical Japanese title on the upper left: 「希望」, distressed cream ink.
2. Small red seal stamp beside the left title with Japanese characters resembling 「竈門 炭治郎」.
3. Vertical Japanese text box on the upper right: 「心を燃やせ 全てを懸けて」 with a smaller line 「鬼滅の刃」.
4. Vertical Japanese text box on the lower left: 「命を繋ぎ、未来を照らすために」.
5. Dark calligraphy on the right banner: 「鬼滅」.
6. Main Spanish title across the lower third, huge distressed serif capitals: LA VOLUNTAD INQUEBRANTABLE. Put “LA” smaller above “VOLUNTAD”, and “INQUEBRANTABLE” below.
7. Red small-credit line under the title: TANJIRO KAMADO.
8. Small white subtitle under that: KIMETSU NO YAIBA.
9. Bottom row contains exactly three icon-caption blocks: left sunburst icon with “UN HERMANO. UNA PROMESA.”, center lotus icon with “UN CAMINO DE SACRIFICIO.”, right checker-square icon with “UNA ESPERANZA QUE NUNCA MUERE.”
10. Bottom-left small boxed technique label with Japanese text and English meaning: 「水の呼吸 / 壱ノ型 / 水面斬り」.
11. Bottom-center circular seal emblem containing the large kanji 「滅」 and tiny ring text.
12. Bottom-right small boxed technique label: 「竈門炭治郎」 and “WATER BREATHING / FIRST FORM / WATER SURFACE SLASH”.

Color and style: Use a limited palette of burnt orange, black, charcoal, muted cream, dark green, blood red, and electric cyan water highlights. Typography should be weathered, cracked, and partially eroded. Keep the composition dense and cinematic, with strong backlighting and high contrast.

Constraints: No modern objects, no clean vector look, no extra characters, no extra icons beyond the three bottom icon-caption blocks, no additional title text beyond the listed groups, and keep all Japanese text decorative but legible where possible.\

title: 水墨双重曝光海报
author: PromptLab
categories: 海报 / 传单,插画,水墨 / 中国风,极简主义,角色,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
[Main Subject]
A large, highly recognizable silhouette of a figure (head, face outline, or outer contour) fills the upper portion of the frame as the dominant visual shape. Within the lower and middle area, the same character appears in full body, standing still or in subtle motion, serving as the secondary focal point and visual core.

[Composition]
Double exposure and collage storytelling lives inside and around the large silhouette: multiple scenes, layered imagery, smaller character moments, supporting elements, and environmental layers blend together within clouds, ink wash, and whitewash. Side panels on the left and right echo each other, adding narrative tension and spatial rhythm. A flowing thread of visual cues links the main figure, internal collage, and surrounding silhouette, guiding the eye through the composition.

[Style]
A large portion of the canvas is left as negative white space. Edges are softened with ink stains, frayed brushwork, and dissolving textures, evoking the breath and emptiness of Oriental aesthetics. Overall mood: cohesive, refined, restrained, emphasizing layered storytelling, serialized poster language, and a strong central visual impact.

Aspect ratio: 9:16.\

prompt_en: A highly detailed anime illustration of a seated young woman in an elegant Japanese-inspired fantasy kimono composition, centered on a clean warm off-white background. She has long straight black with deep blue-violet undertones hair with blunt bangs and very long flowing side lengths, with red and blue ribbon strands woven through the hair. Her eyes are large and luminous crimson red, and her expression is calm, soft, and slightly wistful. She wears an ornate floral hairpiece on the right side of her head made of 4 major blossoms in red, white, pale blue, and blue, with dangling gold ornaments and tassels. Her outfit is a richly patterned kimono in red, black, pale blue, cream, and touches of purple, covered in cherry blossoms, stylized flowers, butterflies, cords, bows, and hanging tassel decorations. The sleeves are oversized and flowing, with visible red cord knots and floral appliqué details. She sits in a graceful curled pose with one hand near her face, bare legs prominently visible, wearing white tabi-like socks and elaborate red-and-black platform sandals with bows. Surrounding her are exactly 4 cats: 1 black cat sitting on a branch at left looking upward, and 3 white cats placed around her lower left, mid-right, and lower center-right. Include exactly 2 birds: 1 blue bird perched on the left branch and 1 small red-and-blue bird nestled among flowers at the lower right. Include exactly 3 butterflies: 2 near the upper left and 1 near the lower center by her legs. Frame the composition with plum blossom branches, hanging Japanese ornaments, tassels, diamond charms, and long fabric streamers. Add a large circular decorative motif behind her upper body and a tall vertical banner-like ornament on the right side. The overall palette should balance vermilion red, black, ivory, pale cyan, sky blue, and lavender. Style is polished 2D anime key visual, ultra-clean linework, delicate textile patterning, flat decorative shapes mixed with subtle shading, elegant negative space, highly ornamental but harmonized composition, whimsical and refined, vertical full-body character poster.\

title: 霓虹脉冲偶像简介海报

categories: 海报 / 传单,产品营销,极简主义,插画,群像 / 情侣,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished Japanese idol group profile poster for NEON PULSE, a fictional five-member school-crush themed girl group, designed like a glossy agency debut one-sheet with lavender accents, school uniforms, member bios, and outfit concept previews.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high resolution, soft pastel lavender and white palette, thin purple borders, clean magazine-layout typography, dreamy classroom background with sunlight through large windows. Overall look should combine a K-pop/J-pop idol promotional profile sheet, fashion lookbook, and debut announcement.

Main layout: Use exactly 5 female idol members standing full-body in the large central image, wearing coordinated school uniforms with navy blazers, white shirts, plaid mini skirts, ribbon ties or neckties, knee socks, and loafers. Arrange them shoulder-to-shoulder in a bright classroom. Faces may be softly anonymized or blurred, but hair, clothing, poses, and silhouettes should remain clear. Include a handwritten-style note in the upper right of the central photo reading “School Crush ver.”

Left information panel: At top left, large title “NEON PULSE” with Japanese subtitle beneath it. Add the tagline “Light the Beat.” with a small waveform line and heart icon. Include exactly 3 text blocks: 1) GROUP CONCEPT, describing a neon-like shine and delivering heartbeats of excitement and healing; 2) FANDOM NAME, “SPARKS” with a short explanation; 3) DEBUT DATE, “2026.06.07” followed by a small heart.

Right member profile panel: Add a vertical “MEMBER PROFILE” card listing exactly 5 members, each with a colored star/diamond marker, name, role, birthday, age, height, blood type, personality note, and image color. The five visible members must be: 1) LUNA, center/leader, 2004.02.11, 168cm, cool and reliable, image color purple; 2) AURA, ace, 2003.07.23, 167cm, warm performer, image color gold; 3) RIN, dance leader, 2004.09.05, 165cm, powerful and cool, image color blue; 4) NOA, sub vocal, 2005.01.30, 164cm, mysterious and calm, image color silver; 5) YUI, lead vocal, 2005.04.17, 163cm, cute fan-loving youngest, image color pink.

Middle member cards: Under the main photo, create exactly 5 horizontal profile cards with portrait crops and names: LUNA, AURA, RIN, NOA, YUI. Each card should show a close-up portrait, Japanese name reading under the English name, role, birth date, height, blood type, personality, special skill or appeal point, and a small colored gemstone matching her image color. Keep each card compact and elegant.

Bottom outfit collection: Add an “OUTFIT COLLECTION” strip with exactly 7 concept thumbnails, each showing the same 5-member group in a different coordinated stage outfit. Label the seven thumbnails clearly: 1) Neon Black, dark black-and-purple neon idol outfits; 2) School Crush, the school uniform look; 3) White Angel, white angelic stage dresses; 4) Red Carpet, mature black-and-red glamorous outfits; 5) Cyber Girl, futuristic blue-and-white cyber outfits; 6) Summer Live, bright denim-and-white summer styling; 7) Moonlight, mysterious purple moonlit stage outfits. Include a short Japanese-style description under each thumbnail and a small colored heart/gem accent.

Visual style: Crisp editorial graphic design, pastel lavender frame lines, subtle sparkles, small hearts, diamond icons, waveform motifs, elegant serif title mixed with clean sans-serif body text, a soft glow around the central classroom scene. Make the poster information-dense but tidy and legible, like an official idol debut profile sheet.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 members and exactly 7 outfit thumbnails. Preserve the visible English labels and member names. Avoid adding extra members, extra outfit concepts, watermarks, QR codes, or unrelated logos. Keep the design square, balanced, and highly readable.\

Goal: Create a high-resolution Japanese tourism PR poster for Toyohashi City, combining an emotional anime travel illustration with a dense collage of local attractions, foods, and landmarks.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, bright cinematic daylight, ultra-detailed 2K feel. Use a saturated blue sky with white clouds and warm golden sunset light. The composition should feel like an official municipal promotional poster, polished and information-rich.

Main visual: Center a beautiful anime-style young woman seen from behind and slightly in profile, standing in a scenic city overlook. She has long flowing deep blue hair blowing dramatically in the wind, delicate hair ornaments, a white short-sleeve blouse, and a light blue skirt. She carries a cream tote bag printed with “TOYOHASHI” and small blue city-line art. Her face area should be softly obscured or turned away so the poster focuses on place and atmosphere. Add a small schoolgirl-like figure in the midground looking over the city, reinforcing nostalgia and travel.

Top headline text: Large elegant white Japanese calligraphy-style title across the upper left: 「住みたくなるまち、豊橋市」. Add smaller handwritten-style subcopy nearby: 「今日も、明日も、このまちが好きになる」. Use strong drop shadows so the text remains legible against the sky.

Right sidebar: Create a cream rounded vertical panel titled 「豊橋市の魅力10選」. It must contain exactly 10 numbered attraction cards, each with a small photo-like thumbnail and Japanese label:
1. 「のんほいパーク」 with an elephant/giraffe zoo image
2. 「手筒花火」 with handheld fireworks sparks
3. 「路面電車」 with a streetcar image
4. 「豊橋カレーうどん」 with curry udon bowl
5. 「『負けヒロインが多すぎる！』聖地巡礼」 with a seaside or school-route scene
6. 「花のまち豊橋」 with colorful flowers
7. 「葦毛湿原」 with wetland greenery
8. 「ブラックサンダー」 with a chocolate bar close-up
9. 「ヤマサちくわ」 with chikuwa fish cakes
10. 「うずら卵」 with quail eggs

Collage elements: Include exactly 10 major attraction/food elements integrated around the poster: a zoo scene with giraffe and elephant on the left, a brick windmill and flower field in the upper right background, handheld fireworks in the lower left, a red-and-white streetcar labeled “3203,” a large bowl of Toyohashi curry udon, a Black Thunder chocolate bar package, Yamasa chikuwa fish cakes, a small bowl of quail eggs, a river/canal landscape with bridge and birds, and abundant foreground flowers. Add small vertical Japanese label tags near some collage items such as 「のんほいパーク」, 「手筒花火」, 「路面電車」, 「豊橋カレーうどん」, 「ヤマサちくわ」, and 「うずら卵」.

Mid and lower text: Add a small sign near the overlook reading 「豊橋へようこそ」. Add a vertical poetic phrase near the windmill/flowers: 「花も 空も 未来も ここにある。」. Near the bottom, place white and yellow promotional copy: 「豊かな自然、便利な暮らし、あなたらしい人。」 followed by a larger closing line 「それが、豊橋。」 with “豊橋” emphasized in yellow.

Footer: Bottom right should show a white rounded municipal logo block with a simple blue emblem and the text 「豊橋市」 plus small roman letters “TOYOHASHI CITY”.

prompt_en:

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 fashion mood-board collage, ultra high resolution, split into exactly 4 image panels in a clean grid: two panels on the top row and two panels on the bottom row. No captions, no logos, no watermarks.

Layout and panel count: Include exactly 4 discrete fashion shots. Panel 1, top left: full-body front runway pose, the model centered in an ethereal crystal ice palace, gown falling to the reflective floor with sparkling particles around the hem. Panel 2, top right: close-up crop from shoulder to head area focusing on the chrome collar necklace, iridescent skin highlights, short bob hair, and a dangling abstract crystal earring. Panel 3, bottom left: dramatic low-angle side view of the model walking or posing, showing the high slit and an extremely long translucent train sweeping across the reflective floor. Panel 4, bottom right: overhead top-down view of the model spinning or opening the gown into a circular flower-like shape, surrounded by glowing concentric cyan and violet rings like a magical sci-fi portal.

Setting: a towering crystalline ice palace with transparent arches, floating diamond-shaped crystals, mirrored wet floors, and aurora-like vertical light beams. The environment should feel like a future couture runway inside an alien glacier cathedral, with shimmering frost, glittering ice dust, neon reflections, and deep atmospheric depth.

Visual style: Hyperrealistic fashion photography mixed with futuristic fantasy surrealism, glossy editorial lighting, cinematic contrast, high-detail fabric physics, prismatic reflections, pearlescent lavender, cyan, teal, silver, and violet color palette. The gown should look semi-transparent, metallic, holographic, and wet-shiny, with rainbow caustics and sparkling highlights. Use dramatic rim light, soft beauty lighting on skin, and magical volumetric glow.

The face may be softly obscured or de-emphasized, but the fashion styling and jewelry must remain clear. Jewelry count: exactly 2 prominent jewelry elements — one sculptural chrome collar necklace with a central pendant, and one dangling crystal earring visible in the close-up.

Constraints: Keep the collage seamless and coherent as one editorial series. Use exactly four panels and exactly one model throughout. Avoid extra people, text, product labels, modern furniture, warm earthy colors, cartoon styling, or clutter. Maintain an icy lavender-cyan futuristic couture mood throughout.\

Outfits must be natural and follow realistic pet wearing logic; the positions of limbs, neck, ears, and tail must be natural. The 6 specific frames: 1. Front half-body shot, wearing small black sunglasses, cool expression, like a streetwear brand cover. 2. Close-up headshot, sunglasses pushed up to the top of the head, sticking out tongue or slightly open mouth, funny and cute expression. 3. Side or 3/4 side shot, wearing a black and white fleece jacket, one paw naturally raised as if posing. 4. Front sitting shot, wearing a white high-collar zip-up jacket, small sunglasses, look with attitude. 5. Slightly low-angle shot, looking at the camera with chin up, wearing headphones or lightweight accessories, like a pet DJ. 6. Close-up portrait, slight head tilt or looking back at the camera, simple clothing, highlighting facial features and fur details. Quality Requirements: Realistic pet photography, high-definition details, studio quality, real fur, real fabric textures, natural and vivid, cute yet high-end, with a 'Xiaohongshu' viral pet portrait aesthetic. Goal: Create a dark fantasy worldbuilding map for a gothic horror board game or campaign setting, showing a haunted swamp realm at night with branching travel routes.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 illustrated map, antique parchment border, muted blue-green-gray palette, high-detail painterly fantasy concept art. The scene is viewed from above at a slight angle, like an illustrated adventure map.

Layout: Fill the entire canvas with a misty marshland, twisted forests, bog water, ruins, and supernatural landmarks. Add an ornate thin black frame with delicate Victorian filigree corners, skull ornaments in the upper-left and upper-right corners, and a compass rose in the lower-left corner. Use moonlit lighting, fog layers, and small glowing cyan, violet, and ghostly green accents.

Map route system: Draw exactly 34 connected circular route nodes across the map: 28 blank parchment oval nodes and 6 special illustrated medallion nodes. Connect the nodes with pale winding paths that snake through the marsh. The 6 special medallions should show, from left/center to right/bottom: a feather symbol, a skull symbol, a bat-or-crest symbol, an open book symbol, a target-like spiral symbol, and a dead tree symbol. Keep the nodes empty except for these icons; no numbers.

Named location banners: Include exactly 5 curled parchment ribbon labels with readable Portuguese fantasy names: “PORTÃO ESQUECIDO” near the left haunted gate, “CRIPTA DOS LAMENTOS” near the ruined crypt at the upper right, “SAUDAÇÕES DA NÉVOA” near the right-side ruins, “FAROL DA ALMA PERDIDA” near the lower-right lighthouse, and “ATRACADOURO SOMBRIO” near the lower-left dock.

Landmark details: In the upper left, place a distant black gothic castle with many spires beneath a bright full moon and storm clouds. At far left, show an iron cemetery gate glowing faint cyan. In the upper right, show a crumbling mausoleum or crypt with a pale statue in the doorway. At right-center, show jagged ghostly turquoise crystal formations and ruined stones. At lower right, show a lonely crooked lighthouse glowing purple through fog. At lower left, show a rotting wooden dock over dark water with a cyan lantern. Near the center, include a flooded obelisk island, dead trees, swamp pools, a ruined windmill, ghostly figures, and scattered grave markers.

Visual style: Grim, atmospheric, hand-painted, intricate, old-world fantasy cartography mixed with gothic illustration. prompt_en: Use the provided image as the base reference for the original character. Draw a 'CG Gallery Mode' screen from a romance adventure game, gal game, or otome game where the character from the reference image appears. This is not a character design sheet, an album, or a simple collection of illustrations. It is a screen from an actual in-game CG gallery mode opened from the title screen after a player has cleared the game. [Concept] Let viewers naturally feel that 'the game this character appeared in actually existed.' Value the atmosphere of looking back at event CGs unlocked during the main game. Evoke feelings of romance, friendship, youth, daily life, slightly embarrassing memories, and key turning points in the story. [Screen Format] A CG gallery mode screen for a romance ADV game. Establish it as an in-game UI. Display multiple event CG thumbnails in a list. Thumbnails should be arranged neatly but with decorative elements typical of commercial games. Naturally place page numbers, CG unlock rate, back button, category tabs, selection cursor, and locked CG frames. The UI should look convincing for a real romance ADV game, neither too old nor too new. [CG Content] Each thumbnail should depict a different event CG that occurred during the game. All contents should be different memories. Examples: first meeting scene, classroom conversation, walking home after school, sharing an umbrella on a rainy day, school festival, sports festival, school trip, beach event, summer festival, amusement park date, walking home in winter, Christmas, confession scene, graduation ceremony, ending CG, secret route special CG, etc. Include natural event CGs that look like snapshots from the middle of a story, not just posed commemorative photos. [Character Depiction] Depict the character from the reference image as the same person. Maintain the facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye shape, facial habits, atmosphere, character personality, and impression of the costume design. Costumes can naturally change to uniforms, casual wear, yukatas, winter clothes, loungewear, or dress-style outfits for each event CG, but do not turn them into a different character or a photorealistic human. [UI and Texture] Make it look like a screenshot of an actual game screen. The focus of the entire screen is the CG gallery mode, not a standalone illustration. Some thumbnails can include 'LOCKED', '???', or 'unopened' frames. Add a glowing frame or cursor to the currently selected CG. Use a fictional game title logo and menu names. Ensure text is readable and not excessively distorted. [Atmosphere] Nostalgic, sweet, and slightly bittersweet. Looking back at memories after clearing the game. Re-watching favorite scenes. An atmosphere that makes it feel like you played this game in the past, even though it doesn't exist. Create a natural and convincing screen for a commercial romance ADV game's CG gallery mode.\

The male figure is tall and slim, wearing a dark brown or charcoal hoodie with the hood up, white drawstrings, subtle red blood-like stains on the sleeve and lower hem, and dark red pants. His skin is pale, his long black hair falls over one eye, and the lower half of his face is wrapped in dirty white bandages stained with blood, giving him a disturbing but protective antihero presence. The female figure is petite with extremely long straight platinum-blonde hair reaching past her waist, wearing a loose white coat or cardigan over a black-and-white outfit and a black choker. She faces him closely with both hands clasped together against his chest, creating a tender contrast against the horror atmosphere. Add 2 ghostly supporting figures in the background: on the left, a pale blonde girl in shadow wearing striped clothing and holding an object close to her chest; on the right, a hooded male figure in profile with glasses or sharp facial lines, his hood marked by a dark blood stain. The environment is filled with floating shards of broken glass, blue moonlight, dust motes, and star-like particles, with deep navy, black, and icy blue tones throughout. Place a stylized red Japanese title at the top right, 殺戮の天使, with a smaller red serif English subtitle beneath it reading Memory Collection.
